entities.summary: Hilalian, a notable figure in the history of Algeria, associated with Islamic Conquest and Medieval Dynasties (972–1152). Preceded by Hammadid and Zirid Dynasties and Rustamid Dynasty (Tahert). Their legacy influenced Zayyanid Kingdom of Tlemcen and Berber.
